title: How to Use the DUNE Catalog

sections.title: Basic Search
sections.content: Enter your search terms in the search box and select a category. Toggle "Official" to search only official datasets.

sections.title: Categories
sections.content: Each tab has specific categories. Select the appropriate category for your search to narrow down results.

sections.title: Authentication
sections.content: You must be signed in to perform searches. Click the login button in the top right to sign in.

sections.title: Tabs
sections.content: Different tabs organize searches by detector type. You can switch between tabs to access different categories and saved searches.

sections.title: Sorting Results
sections.content: To sort the results of a query, click the column name to sort the column by ascending order, clicking it again will switch to descending.

sections.title: Other Tab
sections.content: The Other tab is for advanced use. Enter a custom MetaCat query (MQL) directly, such as "files from datasets matching hd-protodune:hd-protodune_2919*" to search with your own criteria beyond the standard categories. Below the query box, the Conditions Database panel lets you look up a run by number, or search for runs by beam momentum or by a start/stop time range, and shows the full recorded conditions for each run. You can also combine both: a suggested MetaCat query is generated from your conditions lookup, which you can copy into the query box and extend with additional conditions (for example, "filter dune_runshistdb() (files from datasets matching hd-protodune:hd-protodune_2919*) where runs_history.gain = 7.8") to find files matching specific run conditions in one search.
